headline: Quilter & Textile Artist
bio: I work with traditional quilting techniques and modern textile art. Most days you'll find me piecing fabric in my studio, teaching at the community center, or hunting for vintage patterns at estate sales.
aboutContent:
I've been quilting for fifteen years, starting with my grandmother's patterns and gradually developing my own style that blends traditional patchwork with contemporary design.

These days I focus on wall hangings and art quilts using hand-dyed fabrics and appliqué. I teach a monthly quilting circle at the Portland Public Library and occasionally sell pieces at local craft fairs.

I'm always looking for collaborators interested in textile arts, natural dyeing, or community craft education.

profileElements.value: Open to teaching gigs, gallery shows, and collaboration on textile art projects.

posts.title: Botanical Quilt Wall Hanging
posts.content:
Working on a large wall hanging featuring botanical motifs using appliqué techniques. Combining traditional quilting methods with modern design to create a piece that celebrates native Pacific Northwest plants.

The color palette is drawn from pressed wildflowers I collected last summer — lupine purples, poppy oranges, and fern greens.

updates.title: Appliqué layout finished
updates.content: Got all the leaf shapes cut and pinned. The lupine cluster in the center is working better than I expected — the curved stems give it movement.

updates.title: Quilting the background
updates.content: Started the background quilting with a stipple pattern. It's slow going by hand but the texture difference between the flat appliqué and the quilted background is exactly what I wanted.

posts.title: Fabric Dyeing Experiments
posts.content:
Spent the weekend testing natural dyes on cotton and linen scraps. Avocado pits gave a beautiful blush pink, and black beans produced a dusty blue-grey. Keeping notes on mordants and soak times for reproducibility.

Planning to use these hand-dyed fabrics in my next quilt project.

events.title: Quilting Circle Meetup
events.content:
Monthly quilting circle for all skill levels. Bring your current project or start something new — I'll have fabric scraps and basic supplies for anyone who wants to try quilting for the first time.

We'll share techniques, work on our own projects, and enjoy each other's company. Light refreshments provided.
events.location: Portland Public Library, 801 SW 10th Ave, Portland, OR
